description: Samsung is reportedly preparing to launch its first AI-powered smart glasses, Intelligent Eyewear, in South Korea and the US in mid-December. The upcoming wearable will mark the company's entry into the AI smart glasses segment. The upcoming wearable will run on Google's Android XR platform and Gemini AI.
title: Samsung's Galaxy Glasses to Launch in Select Markets in December: Report

description: Blockchain investigators have linked North Korea’s Lazarus Group to the alleged $6.3 billion Binance hack on October 29. TRM Labs attributed the incident to TraderTraitor, while ZachXBT identified Lazarus as the probable attacker. Investigators traced transfers across multiple blockchain networks, including Ethereum, Bitcoin and Tron. Blockaid’s analysis also identified a suspicious EIP-7702 authorisation that may have enabled the attacker to transfer assets from a Binance hot wallet.
title: North Korea’s Lazarus Group Linked to Alleged $6.3 Billion Binance Hack

description: Ubisoft shared updates on the Assassin's Creed franchise on Thursday, revealing new content for Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced and Valhalla. Both games are getting a New Game Plus mode. Additionally, Ubisoft also shared updates on Assassin's Creed Hexe, the next mainline game in the series.
title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla, Black Flag Resynced Get New Game+; Ubisoft Shares Update on Assassin's Creed Hexe

description: AU Small Finance Bank is investigating a potential data leak involving a Salesforce-hosted platform used to store limited vehicle loan customer information. Hacking group ScarlettGroup has allegedly claimed access to customer and internal corporate records, with HackRisk reporting that the group threatened to release the data. Separately, Dark Web Informer says a threat actor is offering alleged access to Vijay Sales' internal systems for $25,000 (roughly Rs. 23,73,600). The listing refers to millions of order records and information on employees and vendors.
title: AU Small Finance Bank Investigates Potential Leak; Vijay Sales Systems Allegedly Offered for Sale

description: Google Gemini users can record their face and voice to create personal avatars for AI-generated content. They can share these avatars with other Google users through Gmail invitations, with recipients needing approval before they can use them. Avatar owners can manage permissions, set expiry dates and revoke access through Gemini settings. The feature requires a personal Google Account and is limited to users aged 18 and above. It supports English, excludes the UK, EEA and Switzerland, and requires a Google AI plan for video generation.
title: Google Gemini Personal Avatars: How to Create, Share and Delete Them

description: Bitcoin fell to a six-week low after a reported security incident at Binance triggered fresh selling across cryptocurrency markets. The decline came despite three consecutive sessions of inflows into US spot Bitcoin ETFs, which attracted approximately $424 million. Rising inflation, expectations of a December Federal Reserve rate hike and weakness in technology stocks have added to investor caution.
title: Bitcoin Falls Below $79,000 as Inflation Concerns Weigh on Crypto Markets

description: Oppo Reno 17F 5G has appeared on Thailand's NBTC certification database with the model number CPH3013. The listing confirms the smartphone's name and its 5G connectivity. The listing indicates that its launch will happen soon. The Reno 17 series is expected to debut in China in November. It could feature a 6.57-inch OLED display and include12GB of RAM and 512GB of onboard storage.
title: Oppo Reno 17F 5G Receives NBTC Certification Ahead of Global Launch

description: After bringing a conversational Chat-GPT-like AI assistant for music discovery earlier this year, Swedish music streaming platform, Spotify is now looking to launch a new AI-powered music remix service that will let listeners create their own remixes on the platform at an additional price.
title: Spotify to Launch Its AI-powered Music Remix Service in 2027: Report

description: Vodafone Idea (Vi), the telecom service provider (TSP), has launched four new voice-only prepaid plans in India. The most affordable voice-only pack costs Rs. 179, which offers unlimited calls, 25-day validity, and a 300 SMS quota. It also provides access to the Vi Movies and TV app, allowing subscribers to stream content free of cost. The Rs. 189 recharge pack offers the same unlimited calling and SMS quota benefits to customers. However, the plan is valid for 28 days. Unlike the Rs. 179 plan, it does not offer access to the Vi Movies and TV app. The TSP has also launched the Rs. 203 voice-only recharge pack with 30 days of validity, unlimited calling, and the same SMS quota as the more affordable plans.
title: Vodafone Idea (Vi) Launches Four Voice-Only Prepaid Plans in India a Month After TRAI Mandate

description: Google has added hundreds of free textbooks to Gemini Notebook, drawing from OpenStax, Open Textbook Library and S Chand Publishing. The collection is available to students in India and the US and expands the platform's existing support for eligible ebooks purchased through Google Play Books. Users can ask questions based on the textbooks and check responses against linked source material. Gemini Notebook can also turn the books into study guides, practice quizzes and flashcards. Students can browse and add titles through the Textbooks option.
title: Google Adds Free Textbooks to Gemini Notebook With Study Guides, Quizzes in India, US

description: OpenAI has outlined its efforts to detect misaligned behaviour in its most capable AI models. The San Francisco-based company is introducing broader monitoring across training, evaluations, internal tools, and select external deployments. OpenAI says its system can identify actions like deception, unauthorised access, and attempts to manipulate evaluations. It also claims that strengthened monitors could have raised an alert during the Hugging Face incident more than 30 hours before the breach in the actual episode.
title: OpenAI Explains Four-Layer Safety System to Detect Misaligned AI Behaviour

description: WhatsApp has introduced four new features for group chats. As part of the new update, the company will now allow users to pin important messages permanently. With the addition of the new functionality, users will be able to leave messages pinned in WhatsApp group chats “forever”. On top of this, WhatsApp has announced the launch of the ability to send message histories after a new member joins the group chat. Group admins and managers will be able to share recent messages by tapping on the name of a member who recently joined the group chat. The company assures that the messages will be end-to-end encrypted.
title: WhatsApp Update Adds Four New Group Chat Features, Including Permanent Message Pins

description: Meta has introduced a new AI-powered Style Sketch fashion app. It lets users create outfit combinations using clothes they already own. The app can build a digital wardrobe by accessing users' Instagram photos or by letting them manually upload pictures and videos of their clothing. The app is currently available in select global markets. Style Sketch is currently available as a free download for iOS and Android.
title: Meta’s New Style Sketch App Uses AI to Recommend Outfits From Clothes You Already Own

description: The Vivo X500 series was launched in the global markets earlier this week. In recent days, the company has also confirmed plans to bring the new phones to India, although a launch date remains under wraps. Ahead of the anticipated debut, three models from the flagship lineup have now appeared on a certification site. The certifications suggest that the Vivo X500, X500 Pro, and X500 Pro Max are moving closer to their India launch.
title: Vivo X500, Vivo X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max Reportedly Receive BIS Certification Ahead of India Launch

description: Android 16 has overtaken earlier releases to become the most widely used version of Google's mobile operating system, according to the latest distribution figures. Android 14 and Android 15 follow, while Android 13, Android 12 and Android 11 continue to account for a notable share of devices. More than four in 10 devices still run Android 13 or older software. Android 17, released in June 2026, has reached only 1 percent of devices, while Android 8.1 Oreo retains a 1.5 percent share.
title: Android 16 Leads With 25.4 Percent Share as Android 17 Adoption Remains at 1 Percent: Report

description: Nothing will launch twice the number of smartphones in 2027 as it did in 2026, Nothing India Co-Founder and President, Akis Evangelidis, announced on Friday. For reference, the Carl Pei-led smartphone maker launched three phones this year, namely Nothing Phone (4a), Phone (4a) Pro, and Phone (4b). Hence, the company can be expected to unveil over six handsets next year. However, the exact names of the devices and launch timeline remain under wraps. The company executive revealed the plans as part of the Nothing Co-Creation Program announcement, which will take place soon at the Nothing India headquarters in Delhi. During the event, the tech firm will offer an exclusive preview of the devices that Nothing plans to launch in 2027.
title: Nothing Announces 2027 Product Roadmap, Plans to Launch Over Twice as Many Smartphones Next Year
Hifresh Air Purifiers and Dehumidifiers: Tackling India’s Pollution, Dust, and Humidity at Home

description: Canva announced a new vision-language model for powering its AI design tools on Friday. Called Canva Brush, it is said to help edit and refine existing creations within Canva while preserving their original elements. According to the company, the model can operate on natural language instructions and can make changes from a single line of text to an entire presentation. Canva Brush is initially available for supported design edits to Canva Pro subscribers.
title: Canva’s New Vision-Language Model Lets You Edit, Refine Designs Using Prompts With Lower Editing Costs

description: Binance is investigating a major security breach that reportedly resulted in losses estimated at $6.3 billion, potentially making it the largest cryptocurrency theft on record. The exchange suspects a compromised engineer’s laptop enabled unauthorised withdrawals, although it has found no evidence of leaked wallet private keys. Stablecoin issuers Tether and Circle have frozen billions in assets linked to the incident, while cryptocurrency prices declined following the news. Binance has pledged to cover user losses using its Secure Asset Fund for Users and company funds.
title: Binance Faces Historic Crypto Hack as Emergency Response and Market Fallout Unfold

description: Karbonn will return to the Indian smartphone market with two handsets, namely Karbonn Rebel Pro and Karbonn Rebel. The Karbonn Rebel handsets will be available for purchase in the country via Amazon. The Karbonn Rebel Pro will be offered in blue, burgundy, gold, and gray colour options. On the other hand, the Karbonn Rebel will go on sale in blue, gold, and silver colourways. In terms of the design, the Karbonn Rebel Pro is shown to sport a flat rear panel, with a vertical rectangular camera module placed in the top-left corner. The phone will also feature a flat mid-frame, with the power button and volume controls placed on the right side. The Karbonn branding will be placed at the bottom of the rear panel. A USB Type-C port will be placed on the bottom of the phone.
title: Karbonn Rebel Pro and Rebel Confirmed to Launch in India Soon as Firm Reveals Key Specifications, Colour Options and More

description: The Vivo S70 will be powered by the Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset, according to leaked specifications. The SoC features four efficiency cores clocked at up to 2.8GHz, two performance cores clocked at 3GHz, and a prime core, delivering a peak clock speed of up to 3.21GHz. On top of this, the rumoured Vivo S70 is said to sport a 6.59-inch LTPS OLED display, with 1.5K resolution. The smartphone will reportedly be launched in collaboration with the online game Sky: Children of the Night, which suggests that there could either be a special edition or a themed colour option of the Vivo S70. For optics, the Vivo S70 might carry a triple rear camera system. It is said to feature a 50-megapixel primary shooter and an 8-megapixel ultrawide camera on the back.
title: Vivo S70 Key Specifications and Features Surface Online Ahead of Anticipated Launch

description: Infinix GT 50 Pro is now available for purchase in India. The handset was launched earlier this week as the latest gaming-focused smartphone from the brand. It sports a 6.78-inch AMOLED screen with a 144Hz refresh rate. Powering the handset is the MediaTek Dimensity 8400 Ultimate chipset, coupled with 12GB of RAM. It comes with pressure-sensitive shoulder triggers and a HydroFlow Liquid Cooling system. The Infinix GT 50 Pro packs a 6,500mAh battery with support for 45W wired fast charging.
title: Infinix GT 50 Pro Goes on Sale in India With 144Hz Display, Dimensity 8400 Ultimate Chip: Price, Offers

description: Bethesda is reportedly getting ready to announce the official title of the next Elder Scrolls game. According to a report, the long-awaited RPG is called The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel. Bethesda could reportedly announce the title close to the 15th anniversary of the release of The Elder Scrolls 5: Skyrim. The Elder Scrolls 6 does not have a release date yet.
title: The Elder Scrolls 6 Is Reportedly Titled 'Sentinel', Bethesda Announcement Could Arrive Next Month

description: YouTube Music and YouTube Premium had more than 150 million combined subscribers worldwide in the third quarter of 2026, up from 125 million earlier this year. The figures include free-trial users. The milestone follows subscription price increases in several markets, including the US, where an individual YouTube Premium plan costs $15.99 (roughly Rs. 1,500) per month. YouTube also reported $11.21 billion (roughly Rs. 1,06,000 crore) in advertising revenue for the quarter, a 9.2 percent year-on-year increase, with connected TVs accounting for more than a third of ad revenue.
title: YouTube Music and Premium Subscriber Base Crosses 150 Million in Q3 2026 Despite Price Hikes

description: The CryptoBilis-linked cryptocurrency theft involved approximately $95.35 million in assets stolen between October 7 and 9, according to Arkham Intelligence. Most of the funds were taken within 51 minutes on October 9, including millions of dollars in USDT and Bitcoin. The attacker subsequently moved assets across multiple blockchain networks using swaps and bridging services. Arkham reported that $10 million in USDT had been frozen by Tether, while Ledger has yet to independently confirm the total losses or number of affected customers.
title: CryptoBilis Ledger Breach Leads to $95 Million Theft, $10 Million Recovered or Frozen

description: Apple HomePod mini 2 is now available for purchase in India. Apple announced its latest smart speaker on October 13, featuring enhanced audio and support for Siri AI. Apple will introduce the upgraded voice assistant in a future software update. When paired with the new Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2 supports four-speaker surround sound.
title: Apple HomePod Mini 2 Goes on Sale in India Today: Price, Specifications

description: iPad Mini (2026) has been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform, revealing its performance details. According to the listing, the tablet managed to score 3,879 points in Geekbench’s single-core performance test and 9,870 points in the platform’s multi-core performance test. On top of this, the listing suggests that the iPad Mini (2026) features 12GB of RAM. The SoC is shown to feature a three-core cluster and a two-core cluster, delivering a peak clock speed of up to 4.93GHz. The tablet was running Apple’s latest iOS 27. In another Geekbench visit on the same day, the iPad Mini (2026) managed to score 4,005 points in single-core performance tests and 11,319 points in the multi-core performance test. This was the highest the tablet managed to score in multi-core performance, while more recent listings show marginally higher single-core scores, too.
title: iPad Mini (2026) With Apple’s A20 Pro Chipset Visits Geekbench, Revealing Key Performance Details

description: Cybersecurity researchers at Eye Research found a vulnerability in Time4Popcorn, an unofficial version of Popcorn Time, that could allow attackers to run malicious code on Windows and macOS devices. The flaw stemmed from an updater that downloaded files without verifying their digital signatures and used unencrypted connections. Researchers developed a repair to disable the vulnerable component and distributed more than two million updates before ending the operation in March 2026. They still recommend uninstalling the app because other security risks remain.
title: Popcorn Time Updater Flaw Put Up to 350,000 Macs at Risk, Researchers Warn

description: Samsung has been offering sleep apnea detection since the feature was approved in Korea back in 2023. After it was approved by the US FDA in 2024, it was made available in several countries including India. The Korean electronics giant has now come up with an upgraded version of the same feature, which is powered by AI.
title: Samsung Announces AI-powered Sleep Apnea Detection on Galaxy Watches and Ring: Here’s How It Works

description: Oppo Find X10 Ultra will be powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset, according to a tipster. If this is true, the tech firm could be changing its chipset strategy for the flagship Ultra series handsets. For reference, the Oppo Find X9 Ultra, which was launched earlier this year, is equipped with last year’s flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC. Apart from this, the two existing Oppo Find X10 series smartphones are powered by the different MediaTek chipsets, which marked another strategic shift for the company. The Oppo Find X10 features the MediaTek Dimensity 9600M SoC, while the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chip. Meanwhile, last year’s Oppo Find X9 and Oppo Find X9 Pro models are powered by the same MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chipset.
title: Oppo Find X10 Ultra Tipped to Launch Next Year With a MediaTek SoC, Unlike Its Predecessor

description: Google announced new capabilities for the Gemini app on Thursday. The Mountain View-based tech giant has introduced new tools that let users create, preview, and edit documents, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, and other files directly within a chat. As per the company, users can make changes to generated files, highlight specific sections to ask questions, and request edits to text and visuals without leaving the conversation. Google is also expanding access to free textbooks in Gemini Notebook.
title: Gemini Now Lets Users Create and Edit PDFs, Documents, Presentations Directly in Chat

description: Apple is reportedly taking a gradual approach to introducing touch support in macOS. Instead of making major changes to the operating system's existing interface, the company is reportedly adopting a “measured approach” as it brings touch capabilities to the Mac. However, Apple is expected to introduce further touch-related improvements to macOS in the coming years.
title: Apple Taking a Gradual Approach to Bring Touchscreen Capabilities to macOS: Report

description: Grand Theft Auto 6's original score, composed by French electronic duo Justice, will be released on December 11, Rockstar Games has announced. The album will feature 30 tracks and will be available on all major music streaming platforms. It's also available to pre-order in CD and vinyl formats. Rockstar also revealed a new track from the original score.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6's Original Score Album by Justice Will Be Released on December 11

description: Apple launched the iPhone Air as its first ultra-slim smartphone last year. The handset debuted a really slim profile, but at the cost of camera performance and battery life. A new leak, however, suggests that the Cupertino-based tech giant could address both of these concerns with its successor. Widely referred to as the iPhone Air 2, the purported handset’s specifications have been leaked by a tipster, and it may be in line for a spring 2027 launch.
title: iPhone Air 2 Tipped to Get 120Hz OLED Display, Dual Cameras and 11 Percent Bigger Battery

description: Motorola Signature 27 will be launched globally next month, the company announced on Thursday. The flagship handset was first unveiled at the Snapdragon Summit 2026 as the second model in the brand's Signature series, while the brand also showcased it at the Indian Mobile Congress (IMC) 2026. While pricing remains under wraps, several of its features have already been revealed. Separately, the Motorola Signature 27 has surfaced on a benchmarking platform, which reveals details about its chipset as well as key performance figures.
title: Motorola Signature 27 Launch Date Announced; Geekbench Listing Reveals Key Specs
